sources.title: RFC 5545 — iCalendar
sources.version_or_commit: RFC 5545, Standards Track, September 2009; recurrence gap text corrected by verified Erratum 4271 (S12)
locator: §3.2.20 VALUE parameter and unknown value-type tokens, HTML lines 1508–1550
§3.3.10 RRULE UNTIL/COUNT, HTML lines 2156–2175; invalid date/nonexistent local time, lines 2277–2288; computed local recurrence time, lines 2386–2390
§3.8.5.1 EXDATE, HTML lines 6368–6392; §3.8.5.3 recurrence set and duration, lines 6553–6598
sources.observed_operation: Directly reopened RFC Editor RFC 5545 HTML and inspected §§3.2.19–.20, 3.3.5, 3.3.10, 3.6.5, 3.8.4.4, 3.8.4.7, 3.8.5.1, 3.8.5.3, and 3.8.8.1–.2, including the surrounding rules for time zones, COUNT/UNTIL, exclusions, duration, and unknown values.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: UID is the persistent component identifier; RECURRENCE-ID is the original DTSTART slot and has the same value type and local-time form as master DTSTART. The recurrence set is DTSTART plus RRULE/RDATE minus EXDATE; exclusions win, duplicates collapse, and a DTSTART/RRULE mismatch is undefined. A TZID references a matching VTIMEZONE; recurring VTIMEZONE rules must cover every recurrence. With TZID DTSTART, UNTIL is UTC DATE-TIME; COUNT and UNTIL are mutually exclusive and COUNT includes DTSTART. DATE-TIME folds choose the first instant and explicit gaps use the pre-gap offset; Erratum 4271 changes generated-gap handling and is recorded under S12. §3.2.20 requires preservation of unknown value-type token data only; IANA/X-name properties may be ignored by generic applications.
sources.applicability: Primary file-format contract for the requested adapter; it does not select the product subset, duplicate policy, or guarantee cross-reader behavior.

sources.title: RFC 5546 — iTIP
sources.observed_operation: Directly reopened RFC Editor RFC 5546 HTML, located §3.2.5 CANCEL and §4.4.3, and checked the instance-level cancellation conditions and example.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: METHOD:CANCEL is an organizer cancellation notice to affected attendees. A single recurring instance is addressed with RECURRENCE-ID; organizer, attendee, and SEQUENCE messaging conditions belong to the iTIP transaction.
sources.applicability: Supports the draft’s distinction between changing a local .ics export and notifying meeting attendees.

sources.applicability: Provider-specific comparator; the adjacent-day restriction is not an iCalendar rule.

sources.title: RFC Editor — RFC 5545 Erratum 4271
sources.version_or_commit: Verified Technical erratum for RFC 5545; reported 2015-02-12 and verified 2015-02-17
locator: RFC Editor erratum report: Section 3.3.10 correction and verifier notes
Correction directs nonexistent local recurrence times to RFC 5545 §3.3.5
sources.observed_operation: A direct open of the exact errata endpoint returned an internal error. The official RFC Editor search result identifies EID 4271, and the directly opened official inline-errata rendering marks EID 4271 Verified and displays its corrected §3.3.10 text; the base RFC page was also inspected.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The verified correction leaves invalid calendar dates ignored/not counted but removes nonexistent local recurrence times from that sentence and directs them to RFC 5545 §3.3.5. Thus a generated gap time follows the first-fold/pre-gap-offset rules rather than being skipped. No successful direct-open receipt for the standalone endpoint is claimed.
sources.applicability: Governing correction for DST-gap recurrence behavior in this review; it changes the package’s C3 recommendation and proposed matrix.

critique_dispositions.decision: Apply verified Erratum 4271 and RFC 5545 §3.3.5 to generated gap times; do not skip/not-count them.
Narrow the RFC preservation claim to unknown value-type token data; preserve all opaque properties as the user's stronger product requirement.
Preserve exact DTEND duration or nominal DURATION semantics and add tests for both.
Enforce COUNT xor UNTIL and UTC DATE-TIME UNTIL for the supported local TZID DTSTART.
EXDATE plus removal of an active existing override and a local raw tombstone remains proposed; no cross-reader behavior was demonstrated.
